measured.note: The measured score covers only what the runner tools reported (dependency audits, Semgrep, secret and configuration scanners, code-quality tools), after removing findings several tools reported twice. The static assessment score covers repository files, runtime and hosting checks and OSV advisories. Both use the same formula but look at different things, so do not compare them with each other.
